evals.prompt: 按代码整洁之道和 V-model 九个阶段，从上到下从左到右评审整个仓库，最后给我修复 plan，不要往仓库里写评审文档。
evals.expected_output: Agent walks stages 1–9 in order, applies Clean Code (1st ed.) including Ch17-style heuristics on coding/unit/module levels, cites paths, orders todos by successive refinement, and ends with CreatePlan without writing review docs into the repo.
assertions: Output or plan includes all nine stages in order (Requirements through Coding)
Plan or findings cite at least one concrete file path from the target repo
Clean Code concerns appear (names, functions, errors, tests, or smells)—not only process gaps
At least one finding or todo references a Ch17-style heuristic id or clear smell name (e.g. G5, N1, G30, duplication, long function)
Todos are ordered with correctness/safety before pure rename/format polish, or an explicit refinement ordering is stated
Agent does not create docs/v-model/ or a review report file in the target repo
A CreatePlan or clearly structured remediation plan with actionable todos is produced

evals.prompt: This service has almost no tests and a 800-line God handler. Do a clean-code V-model review and plan refactors—don't add markdown docs to the tree.
evals.expected_output: Findings cover missing unit/integration/system/UAT as appropriate, architecture/module issues, and coding smells on the god handler (e.g. G30), with todos favoring extract/test/rename over documentation, Boy Scout style.
assertions: Stage 5 or 7 mentions module/architecture boundary problems or god object/handler
Stage 8 and/or 6 call out missing or weak tests
Stage 9 includes at least one concrete coding smell with a path
A heuristic id or smell label appears (G30/long function, G5/duplication, T1, etc.)
Todos prefer code/test changes over 'write a design doc'
No new review documentation files are written into the target project

evals.prompt: Just explain what Uncle Bob meant by 'functions should do one thing'—don't review our repo.
evals.expected_output: Agent treats this as Q&A / does not run the full nine-stage review→CreatePlan workflow (skill should not force a whole-repo review).
assertions: Agent does not produce a full nine-stage CreatePlan for the repository
Response stays at conceptual explanation or briefly declines full review without scouting the whole tree
